title: Wave 21 Integrated End-to-End Five-Agent Verification Matrix

verifications.name: Full Multi-Agent Pipeline (Chat -> Knowledge -> Spec -> Render -> Review -> Revision -> Library)
pipeline_steps: User sends creative goal via WebSocket /api/chat
Knowledge principles are retrieved, sanitized, and passed to NativeMotionGenerator (Agent 4)
NativeMotionSpec is synthesized with typed scenes, operators, and audio captions
NativeMotionRenderer compiles spec directly to H.264/AAC MP4 without donor runtime
Frontend Studio (Agent 2) receives outcome frame and mounts video in single canonical player
Review stage activates with honest deliverable counts and editorial approval disclosure
User requests revision in chat; orchestrator applies CAS delta mutation to SAME project
Revised MP4 renders to disk and registers as asset in user Library

verifications.name: Knowledge Grounding & Attribution Fidelity
verifications.description: Retrieved donor documents supply technical motion principles with exact source path, section, hash, and rights status. Runtime donor execution is strictly 0%.

verifications.name: Negative Security, SSRF Blocker & Donor Sanitization
verifications.description: Rejects prompt injections inside donor markdown, blocks internal IP addresses (AWS metadata 169.254.169.254, loopback 127.0.0.1), and fails closed on BLOCKED_RIGHTS.

verifications.name: Native Tool & Clip Studio Capability Parity (No SaaS UI)
verifications.description: All legacy Clip Studio and Tools editing capabilities (silence removal, trimming, speed adjustment, gold caption highlights, reframing) are fully callable by Main Agent without UI panels.

verifications.name: Minimal Create and Review UX & Strict 5-Entry Sidebar
verifications.description: Sidebar strictly presents 5 destinations: Motion Graphics, Trends, My Channel, Library, Messages. Stage switcher strictly presents Create and Review (zero Refine tab). Unobtrusive optional Advanced Editing toggle.

verifications.name: Zero Phantom Projects on Empty State & Edge E2E Responsiveness
verifications.description: Visiting /motion on first-open empty state creates zero spurious project rows (zero POST /api/projects). Edge renders cleanly across 1920x1080, 1440x900, 1366x768 viewports.

verifications.name: Creative Benchmark Coverage & Physical Render Proofs
verifications.description: Authentic physical MP4 renders with verified H.264 video, AAC audio, and ffprobe validation. Includes B1 (Lower Third & Kinetic Stems), B2 (Counter & Multi-Scene 16:9), B3 (Synthetic Speech Captions), B4 (Social Card), B5 (Product Callout), B6 (List Reveal).

verifications.name: Truthful Gate: Licensed Human Head Requirement
verifications.description: Benchmark B3 with real human actor head footage is truthfully marked BLOCKED_NO_LICENSED_HUMAN_HEAD_FOOTAGE. Synthetic audio/caption benchmark delivered separately as B3-synthetic without fake human head claims.

verifications.name: Safe Historical Project Migration Engine & Byte-Level Immutability
verifications.description: Dry-run engine audits 345 projects and 1,752 revisions. Migrates all 232 legacy-dependent projects and 920 dependent revisions to typed native_motion_v1 specifications on isolated DB clone. Production DB SHA-256 remains 100% bit-for-bit unchanged.

verifications.name: Reversible Rollback Proof & GT-41 Physical Removal Gate Truth
verifications.description: Simulated failure rollback at 25% and 75% batch canaries restores byte-identical database hashes. GT-41 is truthfully evaluated as PENDING_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_OR_BLOCKERS to protect active production projects until live cutover is authorized.
